meta: DevOps and Cloud Services on Azure and AWS | Argix
DevOps and cloud services: CI/CD, DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and cloud security reviews on Azure and AWS.
h1: DevOps and cloud infrastructure you can rebuild from code
lead: Automated, secure delivery pipelines and cloud environments on Azure and AWS, with security checks built into every release.

items.p: Automated build, test and deployment so releases are frequent, repeatable and reversible.
Code scanning, dependency checks, secret detection and container scanning added to the pipeline, so problems are caught before release.
Docker images and Kubernetes clusters set up to scale, with secure defaults.
Environments defined in code, so they can be reviewed, versioned and rebuilt quickly.
New environments and moves to Azure and AWS, with cost, availability and security planned in.
Logging, alerts, uptime monitoring, backups and recovery plans that have actually been tested.

blocks.lead: We review existing AWS, Azure and Google Cloud accounts, then fix what we find.

items: Fixes applied, or handed to your team
A repeatable baseline for new environments
Evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA audits

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Not always. For many applications a simpler managed service is cheaper and easier to run. We recommend Kubernetes only when the scale or architecture justifies it.

items.p: Web, mobile and API software with security built in.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and PCI DSS readiness.
